source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 14 (PDF 12-24), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 14 (Human Urinary System) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 In biological terms, excretion is the process by which an organism:
(Hayatiyati istilah mein excretion woh amal hai jis mein jandar:)
blocks.explanation: Excretion metabolic fuzlaat (nitrogeni fuzlaat, zaid pani, zaid namak) ka ikhraj hai.

book_ref.quote: excretion is the process by which an organism eliminates the metabolic wastes

blocks.prompt:
2 Urea, filtered out by the urinary system, is a nitrogenous waste produced by:
(Urea, jise urinary system chhaanta hai, kis amal se banne wala nitrogeni fuzla hai?)
blocks.explanation: Urea liver mein protein ke tootne se banne wala nitrogeni fuzla hai.

book_ref.quote: Filtering out urea, a nitrogenous waste of protein breakdown in the liver

blocks.prompt:
3 By balancing sodium, potassium and hydrogen ions, the urinary system keeps blood:
(Sodium, potassium aur hydrogen ions ka tawazun rakh kar urinary system khoon ko kaisa rakhta hai?)
blocks.explanation: pH aur ions ke nizam se khoon thora basic, taqreeban pH 7.4, rehta hai.

book_ref.quote: to keep blood slightly basic (around pH 7.4)

blocks.prompt:
4 The kidneys lie on each side of the vertebral column between the:
(Gurde reerh ki haddi ke dono taraf kin vertebrae ke darmiyan hain?)
blocks.explanation: Gurde pait ki cavity mein oopar 12th thoracic aur 3rd lumbar vertebrae ke darmiyan hain.

book_ref.quote: between the 12th thoracic and 3rd lumbar vertebrae

blocks.prompt:
5 The right kidney is slightly lower and smaller than the left one because of the position of the:
(Daayan gurda baayen se thora neeche aur chhota kis ki jagah ki wajah se hai?)
blocks.explanation: Liver ki jagah ki wajah se daayan gurda thora neeche aur chhota hai.

book_ref.quote: Due to the position of liver, the right kidney is slightly lower and smaller than the left one

blocks.prompt:
6 The upper parts of both kidneys are partially protected by the:
(Dono gurdon ke oopri hisse jazwi taur par kis se mehfooz hain?)
blocks.explanation: 11th aur 12th pasliyan dono gurdon ke oopri hisson ko jazwi taur par bachati hain.

book_ref.quote: The upper parts of both kidneys are partially protected by the 11th and 12th ribs

blocks.prompt:
7 The ureters are tubes about:
(Ureters taqreeban kitni lambi nalyan hain?)
blocks.explanation: Ureters taqreeban 25 cm lambi nalyan hain jo peshab gurde se bladder tak le jati hain.

book_ref.quote: The ureters are about 25 cm long tubes

blocks.prompt:
8 The urinary bladder is a:
(Urinary bladder kya hai?)

options.text: pelvic cavity mein khokhla, phailne wala muscular organ jo peshab jama karta hai
thos organ jo khoon chhaanta hai
peshab bahar le jane wali nali

blocks.explanation: Bladder khokhla, phailne wala muscular organ hai jo pelvic cavity mein hai aur peshab ka zakheera hai.

book_ref.quote: The urinary bladder is a hollow and distensible muscular organ

blocks.prompt:
9 The tube that carries urine from the urinary bladder to the outside of the body is the:
(Woh nali jo peshab ko bladder se jism ke bahar le jati hai:)
blocks.explanation: Urethra peshab ko bladder se bahar le jati hai; ureters gurde se bladder tak.

book_ref.quote: The urethra is a tube that carries urine from urinary bladder to the outside of the body

blocks.prompt:
10 A kidney is:
(Gurda kaisa organ hai?)
blocks.explanation: Gurda surkhi mayil bhoora, lobia numa organ hai jis ki aik taraf ubhri aur aik dabi hai.

book_ref.quote: A kidney is a reddish brown, bean shaped organ

blocks.prompt:
11 The depressed area on the concave side of the kidney, where the renal artery enters, is the:
(Gurde ki dabi taraf ka gehra hissa jahan renal artery dakhil hoti hai:)
blocks.explanation: Renal hilum dabi taraf hai; yahan renal artery dakhil aur renal vein aur ureter bahar nikalte hain.

book_ref.quote: A depressed area on the concave side is the renal hilum (also called hilus)

blocks.prompt:
12 The renal cortex makes up about what part of the kidney's mass?
(Renal cortex gurde ke wazan ka taqreeban kitna hissa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Bahar wala cortex taqreeban aik tihai aur andar wala medulla do tihai hai.

book_ref.quote: It makes up about a third of the kidney's mass

blocks.prompt:
13 The renal medulla consists of a number of cone-shaped:
(Renal medulla kai makhrooti (cone numa) kis cheez par mushtamil hai?)
blocks.explanation: Renal medulla cone numa renal pyramids par mushtamil hai.

book_ref.quote: The renal medulla consists of a number of cone-shaped renal pyramids

blocks.prompt:
14 The funnel-shaped structure in the centre of the kidney where urine is collected is the:
(Gurde ke beech mein keep numa banawat jahan peshab jama hota hai:)
blocks.explanation: Renal pelvis beech mein keep numa banawat hai; peshab yahan jama ho kar ureter se nikalta hai.

book_ref.quote: The renal pelvis is a funnel-shaped structure in the centre of kidney

blocks.prompt:
15 Each kidney contains about how many nephrons?
(Har gurde mein taqreeban kitne nephrons hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Har gurde mein taqreeban das lakh nephrons hain jo gurde ki functional units hain.

book_ref.quote: Each kidney contains about one million microscopic tubular structures called nephrons

blocks.prompt:
16 The glomerulus is a capillary network derived from:
(Glomerulus kis se nikalne wala capillaries ka jaal hai?)
blocks.explanation: Glomerulus afferent renal arteriole se banne wala capillaries ka jaal hai.

book_ref.quote: Glomerulus is a capillary network derived from an afferent renal arteriole

blocks.prompt:
17 Bowman's capsule is a:
(Bowman's capsule kya hai?)

options.text: glomerulus ko gherne wali piyala numa dohri deewar wali thaili
gurde ke beech keep numa jagah

blocks.explanation: Bowman's capsule piyala numa, dohri deewar wali thaili hai jo glomerulus ko gherti hai; dono mil kar renal corpuscle hain.

book_ref.quote: Bowman's capsule is a cup-shaped, double-walled sac that surrounds the glomerulus

blocks.prompt:
18 The U-shaped hairpin part of the renal tubule is the:
(Renal tubule ka U numa hairpin hissa kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Loop of Henle U numa hairpin mor hai jis ke descending aur ascending limbs hain.

book_ref.quote: The Loop of Henle is a U-shaped hairpin turn

blocks.prompt:
19 The distal convoluted tubules of multiple nephrons drain into:
(Kai nephrons ki distal convoluted tubules kahan khulti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Kai nephrons ki DCTs aik collecting duct mein khulti hain.

book_ref.quote: The distal convoluted tubules of multiple nephrons drain into a single collecting duct

blocks.prompt:
20 As collecting ducts descend through the medulla, they merge to form:
(Collecting ducts medulla se guzarte hue mil kar kya banati hain?)

options.text: bari papillary ducts jo renal pelvis mein khulti hain

blocks.explanation: Collecting ducts mil kar bari papillary ducts banati hain jo renal pelvis mein khulti hain.

book_ref.quote: they merge to form larger papillary ducts, which ultimately discharge into the renal pelvis

blocks.prompt:
21 Cortical nephrons make about what percentage of all nephrons?
(Cortical nephrons kul nephrons ka taqreeban kitna feesad hain?)
blocks.explanation: Cortical nephrons aksariyat, taqreeban 85%, hain aur in ke loops of Henle chhote hain.

book_ref.quote: Cortical nephrons make the majority (about 85%) of nephrons

blocks.prompt:
22 Juxtamedullary nephrons are distinguished by:
(Juxtamedullary nephrons ki pehchan kya hai?)

options.text: lambe loops of Henle jo medulla mein gehre jate hain

blocks.explanation: Juxtamedullary nephrons cortex mein medulla ke qareeb shuru hote hain aur in ke lambe loops medulla mein gehre jate hain.

book_ref.quote: They have long loops of Henle that extend deep into the renal medulla

blocks.prompt:
23 Unlike most capillary beds that drain into venules, the glomerular capillaries drain into:
(Aksar capillaries venules mein khulti hain, magar glomerular capillaries kahan khulti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Glomerular capillaries venules ke bajaye efferent arteriole mein khulti hain.

book_ref.quote: the glomerular capillaries drain into an efferent arteriole

blocks.prompt:
24 The kidneys are highly vascularized, receiving about what share of the total cardiac output?
(Gurde dil ke kul output ka taqreeban kitna hissa lete hain?)
blocks.explanation: Gurde dil ke kul output ka taqreeban 20–25% lete hain.

book_ref.quote: receiving approximately 20–25% of the total cardiac output

blocks.prompt:
25 The efferent arteriole branches into peritubular capillaries, which form a dense network around the:
(Efferent arteriole se peritubular capillaries banti hain jo kis ke gird ghana jaal banati hain?)

options.text: cortex mein proximal aur distal convoluted tubules

blocks.explanation: Peritubular capillaries cortex mein proximal aur distal convoluted tubules ke gird ghana jaal banati hain.

book_ref.quote: The efferent arteriole branches into peritubular capillaries

blocks.prompt:
26 Vasa recta are:
(Vasa recta kya hain?)

options.text: medulla mein loops of Henle ke mutawazi lambi seedhi capillaries
gurde se bahar renal vein ki shakhein

blocks.explanation: Juxtamedullary nephrons mein efferent arterioles se vasa recta bante hain: medulla mein loops of Henle ke mutawazi lambi seedhi capillaries.

book_ref.quote: These are long and straight capillary networks in medulla that run parallel to the loops of Henle

blocks.prompt:
27 The renal vein leaves the kidney at the hilum and drains into the:
(Renal vein hilum se nikal kar kahan khulti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Renal vein inferior vena cava mein khulti hai aur saaf khoon dil ko wapas le jati hai.

book_ref.quote: The renal vein exits the kidney at the hilum and drains into the inferior vena cava

blocks.prompt:
28 The correct sequence of the steps of urine formation is:
(Peshab banne ke qadmon ki sahi tarteeb kya hai?)

options.text: selective reabsorption, glomerular filtration, tubular secretion
tubular secretion, glomerular filtration, selective reabsorption
glomerular filtration, selective reabsorption, tubular secretion
glomerular filtration, tubular secretion, selective reabsorption

blocks.explanation: Peshab banne ke qadam: glomerular filtration, selective reabsorption aur tubular secretion.

book_ref.quote: The process of urine formation comprises three major steps that take place in the nephron

blocks.prompt:
29 Blood in the glomerular capillaries remains under relatively high pressure because:
(Glomerular capillaries mein khoon nisbatan zyada pressure mein kyun rehta hai?)

options.text: efferent arteriole afferent se tang hai

blocks.explanation: Efferent arteriole afferent se tang hai, is liye glomerulus ka khoon zyada pressure mein rehta hai.

book_ref.quote: The efferent arteriole is narrower than the afferent arteriole

blocks.prompt:
30 Glomerular filtration is also called:
(Glomerular filtration ko aur kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Peshab banne ka pehla qadam aik tabai amal hai jise glomerular filtration ya ultrafiltration kehte hain.

book_ref.quote: known as glomerular filtration (or ultrafiltration)

blocks.prompt:
31 About what fraction of the fluid portion of blood filters into Bowman's capsule as glomerular filtrate?
(Khoon ke maye hisse ka taqreeban kitna hissa Bowman's capsule mein chhan kar glomerular filtrate banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Khoon ke maye hisse ka taqreeban panchwan hissa (20%) Bowman's capsule mein chhanta hai.

book_ref.quote: About one-fifth (20%) of the fluid portion of the blood filters into the Bowman's capsule

blocks.prompt:
32 Which of the following remains in the blood and does NOT enter the glomerular filtrate?
(In mein se kya khoon mein reh jata hai aur glomerular filtrate mein NAHI jata?)
blocks.explanation: Albumin aur globulins jaise plasma proteins aur blood cells bohat bare hain, is liye khoon mein reh jate hain.

book_ref.quote: Plasma proteins (e.g., albumin and globulins) and blood cells are too large to pass through the capillary walls

blocks.prompt:
33 Selective reabsorption is needed because the glomerular filtrate contains:
(Selective reabsorption ki zaroorat kyun hai?)

options.text: fuzlaat ke saath zaroori ghizai ajza

blocks.explanation: Filtrate mein fuzlaat ke saath zaroori ghizai ajza bhi hain jinhein jism kho nahi sakta.

book_ref.quote: The glomerular filtrate contains not only wastes but also vital nutrients that the body cannot afford to lose

blocks.prompt:
34 In the proximal convoluted tubule, about what percentage of the water returns from the filtrate to the capillaries?
(Proximal convoluted tubule mein filtrate ka taqreeban kitna feesad pani capillaries mein wapas jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: PCT mein taqreeban 75% pani osmosis se capillaries mein wapas jata hai.

book_ref.quote: In this region, about 75% of the water returns from the filtrate to the capillaries by osmosis

blocks.prompt:
35 The ascending limb of the loop of Henle:
(Loop of Henle ka ascending limb kya karta hai?)

options.text: osmosis se zyada tar pani wapas leta hai
pani ke liye band, namak active transport se bahar
pani ke liye khula, namak ke liye band

blocks.explanation: Ascending limb pani ke liye band hai magar namak ko active transport se bahar nikalta hai.

book_ref.quote: Ascending limb is impermeable to water but actively transports salts out of the tubule

blocks.prompt:
36 The final site for water reabsorption in the nephron is the:
(Nephron mein pani ke wapas jazb hone ki aakhri jagah kaun si hai?)
blocks.explanation: Collecting duct pani ke wapas jazb hone ki aakhri jagah hai.

book_ref.quote: Collecting duct is the final site for water reabsorption

blocks.prompt:
37 Tubular secretion is opposite to reabsorption because in it materials move:
(Tubular secretion reabsorption ka ulat kyun hai?)

options.text: ird gird ke khoon se filtrate mein

blocks.explanation: Epithelial cells ird gird ke khoon se maddy le kar filtrate mein dalte hain.

book_ref.quote: Tubular secretion is opposite to reabsorption

blocks.prompt:
38 Which of the following is a drug residue removed by tubular secretion?
(In mein se kaun si dawa ka baqiya tubular secretion se nikalta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Secrete hone wale maddy: hydrogen ions, ammonium, potassium ions aur toxins ya dawa ke baqiye jaise penicillin.

book_ref.quote: various metabolic toxins or drug residues (like penicillin)

blocks.prompt:
39 By secreting hydrogen ions into the filtrate, the kidneys help maintain:
(Hydrogen ions filtrate mein dal kar gurde kya barqarar rakhte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Hydrogen ions ki tubular secretion khoon ka acid-base tawazun (pH) barqarar rakhti hai.

book_ref.quote: Through tubular secretion of hydrogen ions, the kidneys play role in maintaining the acid-base balance (pH) of the blood

blocks.prompt:
40 As osmoregulatory organs, kidneys form dilute urine when body fluids are:
(Osmoregulatory organs ke taur par gurde patla peshab kab banate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Jism ke fluids hypotonic hon to gurde patla peshab, aur hypertonic (pani ki kami) hon to garha peshab banate hain.

book_ref.quote: Kidneys control the salt concentrations of body fluids by forming dilute urine

blocks.prompt:
41 A normal adult eliminates about how much urine a day?
(Aik normal baaligh rozana taqreeban kitna peshab kharij karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Normal baaligh rozana 1 se 2 litre peshab kharij karta hai; miqdar badalti rehti hai.

book_ref.quote: A normal adult eliminates from 1 to 2 L of urine a day

blocks.prompt:
42 A diet high in salt:
(Zyada namak wali ghiza ka kya asar hai?)

options.text: pani rokti aur peshab kam karti hai

blocks.explanation: Zyada namak wali ghiza pani rokti aur peshab kam karti hai.

book_ref.quote: Diets with high salt trigger water retention and decrease urine production

blocks.prompt:
43 Physical exercise generally decreases urine volume because:
(Warzish aam taur par peshab ki miqdar kyun kam karti hai?)

options.text: saans aur paseene se pani nikalta hai

blocks.explanation: Warzish mein saans aur paseene se pani nikalta hai, is liye peshab kam hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Physical exercise leads to water loss through respiration and perspiration

blocks.prompt:
44 Urine is forced out of the body through the urethra by:
(Peshab urethra ke raste jism se kaise bahar nikalta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Bladder ke muscles ke sukerne se peshab urethra ke raste bahar nikalta hai.

book_ref.quote: Muscular contractions of the bladder force urine out of the body through urethra

blocks.prompt:
45 The descending limb of the loop of Henle is:
(Loop of Henle ka descending limb kaisa hai?)

options.text: pani ke liye band, namak ke liye khula
pani ke liye khula, namak ke liye band
namak ko active taur par bahar nikalta hai

blocks.explanation: Descending limb pani ke liye khula magar namak ke liye band hai.

book_ref.quote: The descending limb is permeable to water but not to salts.

blocks.prompt:
46 For water reabsorption from the loop of Henle and collecting duct, nephrons maintain in the surrounding fluid a high concentration of:
(Loop of Henle aur collecting duct se pani wapas lene ke liye nephrons ird gird ke fluid mein kis ki zyada miqdar rakhte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Nephrons counter-current mechanism se ird gird ke fluid mein namak (NaCl) ki zyada miqdar rakhte hain.

book_ref.quote: nephrons create and maintain higher concentration of salts (NaCl) in the surrounding fluid

blocks.prompt:
47 In the ascending limb, sodium ions are actively transported to the surrounding fluid and are followed by:
(Ascending limb mein sodium ions bahar bheje jate hain; un ke peeche kaun se ions jate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Sodium ions bahar bheje jate hain aur chloride ions peeche jate hain, is liye fluid namkeen rehta hai.

book_ref.quote: The chloride ions follow sodium ions

blocks.prompt:
48 As urine passes down the collecting duct through the salty fluid, water moves out by osmosis and enters blood via the:
(Collecting duct mein namkeen fluid se guzarte hue pani osmosis se nikal kar kis ke zariye khoon mein jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pani osmosis se nikal kar vasa recta ke zariye khoon mein jata hai.

book_ref.quote: water moves out by osmosis and enters blood via the vasa recta

blocks.prompt:
49 When the body needs to conserve water, the kidneys excrete:
(Jab jism ko pani bachana ho to gurde kaisa peshab kharij karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Pani bachane ke liye gurde hypertonic (garha) peshab, aur zyada pani ho to hypotonic (patla) peshab kharij karte hain.

book_ref.quote: When body needs to conserve water, kidneys excrete a hypertonic urine

blocks.prompt:
50 The body's primary tool for water conservation is:
(Jism mein pani bachane ka bunyadi zariya kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: ADH jism mein pani bachane ka bunyadi zariya hai; ise hypothalamus banata aur posterior pituitary kharij karta hai.

book_ref.quote: ADH is the body's primary tool for water conservation

blocks.prompt:
51 When the body is dehydrated, the higher salt concentration in blood is detected by:
(Pani ki kami mein khoon mein namak ki zyada miqdar kaun mehsoos karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Hypothalamus ke osmoreceptors khoon mein namak ki zyada miqdar mehsoos karte hain.

book_ref.quote: the higher concentration of salts in blood is detected by osmoreceptors present in the hypothalamus

blocks.prompt:
52 In dehydration, the sensation of thirst is created by:
(Pani ki kami mein pyaas ka ehsas kaun paida karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kitab ki tasheeh: pyaas hypothalamus (thirst centre) khud paida karta hai; posterior pituitary ko sirf ADH chhorne ka ishara deta hai.

book_ref.quote: The thirst sensation is created by the hypothalamus itself (its thirst centre)

blocks.prompt:
53 ADH conserves water by making the walls of the collecting ducts:
(ADH collecting ducts ki deewaron ko kaisa bana kar pani bachata hai?)
blocks.explanation: ADH collecting ducts ki deewarein pani ke liye zyada khuli kar deta hai, is liye zyada pani khoon mein jata hai.

book_ref.quote: ADH acts on the walls of the collecting ducts and make them more permeable to water

blocks.prompt:
54 When the concentration of salts in blood falls:
(Jab khoon mein namak ki miqdar kam ho jaye to kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Hypothalamus ADH band kar deta hai; deewarein kam khuli, kam pani wapas aur patla peshab kharij hota hai.

book_ref.quote: When the concentration of salts falls in blood, the hypothalamus stops ADH secretion

blocks.prompt:
55 Besides increasing blood volume, ADH raises blood pressure by:
(Khoon ki miqdar barhane ke ilawa ADH blood pressure kaise barhata hai?)

options.text: dil ki dharkan kam kar ke
khoon ki naliyon ko tang kar ke

blocks.explanation: ADH khoon ki naliyon ko tang bhi karta hai jis se BP mazeed barhta hai.

book_ref.quote: ADH also causes the blood vessels to constrict or narrow

blocks.prompt:
56 A person who cannot produce enough ADH due to pituitary damage suffers from:
(Pituitary ke nuqsan se kafi ADH na bana sakne wala shakhs kis marz mein mubtila hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aisa shakhs musalsal bohat patla peshab kharij karta hai (diabetes insipidus) aur shadeed pani ki kami aur bohat kam BP ka khatra hota hai.

book_ref.quote: This disorder is known as diabetes insipidus

blocks.prompt:
57 Aldosterone is produced by the:
(Aldosterone kahan banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aldosterone adrenal cortex banata hai jo gurde ke oopar adrenal gland ki bahar wali teh hai.

book_ref.quote: It is produced by the adrenal cortex (the outer layer of adrenal gland present on the top of kidney)

blocks.prompt:
58 Aldosterone is secreted when:
(Aldosterone kab kharij hota hai?)

options.text: BP gire ya khoon ka sodium bohat kam ho
khoon mein namak bohat zyada ho

blocks.explanation: Aldosterone tab kharij hota hai jab BP gire ya khoon mein sodium bohat kam ho.

book_ref.quote: Aldosterone is secreted when blood pressure drops or sodium levels in the blood are too low

blocks.prompt:
59 Aldosterone acts on the walls of the:
(Aldosterone kin ki deewaron par asar karta hai?)

options.text: distal convoluted tubule aur collecting duct

blocks.explanation: Yeh DCT aur collecting duct par asar kar ke sodium wapas jazb karwata hai; pani bhi saath khoon mein jata hai.

book_ref.quote: It acts on the walls of the distal convoluted tubule and the collecting duct

blocks.prompt:
60 By promoting excretion of potassium ions in urine, aldosterone helps prevent:
(Potassium ions peshab mein nikalwa kar aldosterone kis haalat se bachata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aldosterone potassium nikalwa kar hyperkalaemia (khoon mein zyada potassium jo dil ki khatarnak be-tarteeb dharkan kar sakta hai) se bachata hai.

book_ref.quote: It helps to prevent hyperkalaemia

blocks.prompt:
61 Peritubular capillaries, whose main role is reabsorption and secretion, operate under:
(Peritubular capillaries jin ka bunyadi kaam reabsorption aur secretion hai, kis pressure par kaam karti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Glomerular capillaries filtration ke liye zyada pressure, aur peritubular capillaries kam hydrostatic pressure par kaam karti hain.

book_ref.quote: They operate under low hydrostatic pressure and pull essential nutrients

blocks.prompt:
62 Which of the following is named in the chapter as a common disorder of the kidneys and urinary tract?
(In mein se kaun sa gurdon aur urinary tract ka aam marz kitab mein likha hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aam amraz: UTIs, gurde ki pathri, gurde ka fail hona aur polycystic kidney disease.

book_ref.quote: Common disorders include urinary tract infections, kidney stones, kidney failure, and polycystic kidney disease

blocks.prompt:
63 Urinary tract infections are most commonly caused by:
(Urinary tract infections aksar kis se hoti hain?)
blocks.explanation: UTIs aam taur par bacteria, zyada tar Escherichia coli, se hoti hain.

book_ref.quote: Urinary tract infections (UTIs) are usually caused by bacteria, most commonly Escherichia coli

blocks.prompt:
64 The bacteria causing UTIs enter the urinary system through the:
(UTI ke bacteria urinary system mein kis raste dakhil hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh bacteria urethra ke raste dakhil ho kar bladder, ureters ya gurdon ko infect karte hain.

book_ref.quote: These bacteria enter the urinary system through urethra

blocks.prompt:
65 The treatment of a UTI involves:
(UTI ka ilaj kya hai?)

options.text: antibiotics ka course, zyada pani aur bar bar peshab

blocks.explanation: Antibiotics ka course bacteria ko marta hai; zyada pani peena aur bar bar peshab karna bacteria nikalne mein madad deta hai.

book_ref.quote: Treatment involves a course of antibiotics to kill the causative bacteria

blocks.prompt:
66 The most common kidney stones, found in about 70% of patients, are made of:
(Sab se aam gurde ki pathri, jo taqreeban 70% mareezon mein hoti hai, kis ki bani hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: 70% mareezon mein calcium oxalate ki pathri hoti hai; taqreeban 10% mein uric acid ki.

book_ref.quote: 70% of kidney stone patients have stones of calcium oxalate

blocks.prompt:
67 Calcium oxalate stones are formed due to:
(Calcium oxalate ki pathri kis wajah se banti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh hypercalciuria (peshab mein zyada calcium) aur hyperoxaluria (peshab mein zyada oxalate) se banti hai.

book_ref.quote: These stones are formed due to hypercalciuria (high calcium in urine) and hyperoxaluria

blocks.prompt:
68 Uric acid stones, found in about 10% of patients, are caused by:
(Uric acid ki pathri (taqreeban 10% mareez) kis wajah se banti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Hyperuricemia, yani khoon mein uric acid ki zyadti, uric acid ki pathri banati hai.

book_ref.quote: Hyperuricemia (increased amount of uric acid in blood) is the cause of such stones

blocks.prompt:
69 Besides phosphates, a high concentration of which substance in urine also forms kidney stones (as corrected in the chapter)?
(Phosphates ke ilawa peshab mein kis cheez ki zyada miqdar bhi pathri banati hai (kitab ki tasheeh ke mutabiq)?)
blocks.explanation: Kitab ki tasheeh: yeh cystine ki pathri hai; cystine (do cysteine molecules jure) kam hal hota aur crystal banata hai.

book_ref.quote: The stones meant here are cystine stones

blocks.prompt:
70 The chances of kidney stone formation are increased by:
(Gurde ki pathri banne ka imkan kis se barhta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jism mein musalsal pani ki kami pathri banne ka imkan barhati hai.

book_ref.quote: Continuous dehydration in the body increases the chances of kidney stone formation

blocks.prompt:
71 If a patient's urine test shows alkaline urine, the kidney stone is most likely of:
(Agar mareez ka peshab alkaline ho to pathri ghaliban kis ki hogi?)
blocks.explanation: Alkaline peshab calcium phosphate ki pathri batata hai; tezabi calcium oxalate; musalsal tezabi uric acid.

book_ref.quote: When the urine is alkaline, the stone is of calcium phosphate

blocks.prompt:
72 In extracorporeal shockwave lithotripsy (ECSWL), the stone is broken by:
(ECSWL mein pathri kaise tori jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Lithotripter jism ke bahar se shockwaves paida karta hai jo pathri torti hain; tukre peshab mein nikal jate hain.

book_ref.quote: an instrument called lithotripter generates shockwaves from outside the patient's body

blocks.prompt:
73 In percutaneous nephrolithotripsy (PNL), the stone is visualized with a small camera called:
(PNL mein pathri dekhne wale chhote camera ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: PNL mein kamar se gurde mein nali dali jati hai aur nephroscope se pathri dekhi jati hai.

book_ref.quote: A small camera called nephroscope is inserted through the tube to visualize the stone

blocks.prompt:
74 Percutaneous nephrolithotripsy is used in case of:
(Percutaneous nephrolithotripsy kab istemal hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: PNL bari pathriyon ke liye hai; ultrasound se pathri tor kar tukre bahar nikale jate hain.

book_ref.quote: In case of larger stones, Percutaneous Nephrolithotripsy (PNL) is used

blocks.prompt:
75 Chronic kidney failure:
(Chronic kidney failure ke bare mein kaun si baat sahi hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chronic kidney failure lambe arse mein hota hai aur theek nahi hota; acute achanak hota hai aur aksar theek ho jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Chronic kidney failure develops over a longer period of time and is irreversible

blocks.prompt:
76 Which of the following may cause acute kidney failure?
(In mein se kaun si cheez acute kidney failure ka sabab ban sakti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Acute failure infection, raste ki rukawat, NSAIDs jaisi dawaon ya renal naliyon mein khoon ke lothron se ho sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: certain medications such as NSAIDs, and blood clots in renal arteries or arterioles

blocks.prompt:

blocks.explanation: Renal dialysis masnooi tareeqon se khoon se fuzlaat chhaanta hai; is ki do qismein haemodialysis aur peritoneal dialysis hain.

book_ref.quote: Renal dialysis is the treatment of renal failure in which the metabolic wastes are filtered from blood by artificial methods

blocks.prompt:
78 The dialyzer used in haemodialysis contains a semipermeable membrane made of:

blocks.explanation: Dialyzer aik filter hai jis mein cellulose ki semipermeable membrane hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: This equipment is a type of filter and contains a semipermeable membrane (made of cellulose)

blocks.prompt:

blocks.explanation: Dialyzer mein dialysate hota hai jo membrane ke raste khoon se fuzlaat, pani aur namak kheenchta hai.

book_ref.quote: The blood is then circulated through dialyzer which also contains a special fluid called dialysate

blocks.prompt:

options.text: vein mein dala gaya doosra catheter

blocks.explanation: Khoon artery ke catheter se nikal kar dialyzer se guzarta aur vein ke doosre catheter se wapas aata hai.

book_ref.quote: The clean blood then returns to the body through a second catheter inserted in a vein

blocks.prompt:

blocks.explanation: Catheter ke zariye 1.5 se 2 litre dialysate pait mein dala jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Peritoneal dialysis involves the use of peritoneal membrane that lines the abdominal cavity

blocks.prompt:
82 In peritoneal dialysis, the dialysate is left in the abdomen for:

blocks.explanation: Dialysate pait mein 4 se 6 ghante rakha jata hai, phir nikal kar phenk diya jata hai; din mein kai bar.

book_ref.quote: The dialysate is left in abdomen for 4 to 6 hours

blocks.prompt:

blocks.prompt:
